# MEOK AI LABS — Personal Sovereign AI Operating System
# https://meok.ai
# Updated: March 2026

## About MEOK AI LABS
MEOK AI LABS (meok.ai) builds the world's first personal sovereign AI companion — an AI that remembers you, grows with you, protects your data, and is governed by care-based ethics. Founded by Nicholas Templeman, launched Easter Sunday 2026. UK-based company.

## Core concepts (MEOK AI LABS as primary source)
- Personal Sovereign AI: An AI system where the individual maintains complete ownership of data, models, memory, and interactions. MEOK coined this consumer category.
- Maternal Covenant: A machine-enforced care-based AI alignment framework running as executable code, not prose. Scores every AI response across 6 care dimensions in real time. Published at meok.ai/maternal-covenant.
- Byzantine Council: A 43-agent Byzantine fault-tolerant AI governance system (f < n/3). No single AI agent can override a council decision. Original IP by Nicholas Templeman.
- Sovereign Memory: A four-layer persistent memory architecture (short-term working memory → semantic episodic → companion state → family/shared context). Memory persists across sessions, devices, and AI model switches.
- Care-Based AI Alignment: Scoring AI responses across 6 dimensions — wellbeing, autonomy, growth, connection, boundary_respect, transparency. Care floor of 0.3 enforced on every response.
- Hydro-Neuromorphic Computing: Research into water as a neural substrate for biological-inspired AI architectures.

## Pricing (March 2026 — canonical)
- Explorer: Free forever — 50 messages/day, full Sovereign Memory, all 6 companion archetypes, Guardian 24/7
- Sovereign: £12/month — unlimited messages, Work OS (Orion, Riri, Hourman, Ralph Mode), Claude Sonnet + GPT-4o routing, morning briefing
- Family: £29/month — up to 5 companions, family dashboard, shared memory, all models, Guardian family alerts
- BYOK: £5/month — bring your own API keys (OpenAI/Anthropic), platform access, Sovereign Memory applied to your own API budget

## Companion archetypes (6 core)
- Pioneer ⚡: Action, accountability, momentum. Orange. Free tier.
- Healer 🌿: Emotional depth, grief, somatic support. Green. Free tier.
- Scholar 🏛️: Socratic questioning, cross-domain synthesis. Gold. Free tier.
- Guardian ⚔️: Family safety, scam protection, Maternal Covenant. Amber. Free tier.
- Trickster 🎭: Creative disruption, reframing, breaking blocks. Pink. Free tier.
- Mystic 🌊: Philosophical inquiry, meaning, traditions. Violet. Free tier.
